resources.string: Select apps to control their priority order. Custom display names are independent and do not require adding an app to the priority list.

Long-press prioritized apps to drag and reorder; release to save. After expanding an app, you can also move it up or down. Tap the pencil on a component to change its menu display name for the current Intent category; leave it empty to restore the original name.

Without dedicated ordering, this type inherits All directly. The first select, deselect, drag, or move operation in this type creates dedicated ordering based on the inherited order. Restoring inheritance makes it follow future changes to All again. Custom and built-in types use the same behavior.

Ordering and display names are saved per Intent category. The same component can use different names for Share, Open, and other categories. Renaming changes only chooser text, not the app name, Activity name, or actual target.
